network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto documenta l'evento idrometeorologico nel Sannio, ma non pubblica una misura idrometrica sul torrente Cervaro compatibile con il ponte di Baselice. I livelli di Tammaro e Tammarecchia non vengono trasferiti a un corso d'acqua distinto.
network_status.summary_en: The report documents the Sannio hydrometeorological event but publishes no Cervaro stream measurement compatible with the Baselice bridge. Tammaro and Tammarecchia levels are not transferred to a distinct watercourse.

sources.title: Rapporto degli eventi idrometeorologici 14-20 ottobre 2015

curation_note.en: The report documents the Sannio hydrometeorological event but publishes no Cervaro stream measurement compatible with the Baselice bridge. Tammaro and Tammarecchia levels are not transferred to a distinct watercourse.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
